description: Somos un grupo de investigación interesado en aprender y generar nuevos proyectos que nos permitan expandir nuestros conocimientos sobre el espacio.
summary: A prototype of a video game was developed where a mission to Mars is planned, in which players must properly manage the necessary resources to successfully complete it. The main idea of the game is to correctly select the amount of water, oxygen, and food. Later, after some unfortunate calculations, entering the Red Planet causes a collision that drastically changes the status of the mission. Now the astronaut (the player) must gather resources, save the other crew members, complete the original mission, and return home—all while following instructions. It’s important to mention that the real success of the mission depends on choosing the right resources and properly following instructions.
details: Our project consists of a video game prototype in which the player’s mission is to locate parts of their spacecraft scattered across Mars following a crash landing—an event that left the player and their crew stranded on the Red Planet. The initiative is designed to help players develop skills such as decision-making and the effective management of limited resources; it is intended primarily for children and adolescents, who may then apply these skills in their daily lives. We used the Unity Editor to develop the project, employing it to build scenes, integrate video content, and manage game assets. What sets our proposal apart is its combination of space exploration and problem-solving within a video game format. In developing the project, we took into account various factors, including the distance and travel time between Earth and Mars, the Martian environment—such as its temperature, terrain, and atmosphere—and the essential requirements for an astronaut’s survival away from Earth, including oxygen, water, and food.
